title: Tokenized Securities Reach $10B as Internet Capital Markets
description: Tokenized Securities Reach $10B as Internet Capital Markets
keyTakeaways: Tokenized Securities Reach $10B as Internet Capital Markets
body: Tokenized Securities Reach $10B as Internet Capital Markets

sourceReview.reason: The purported new $10B tokenized-securities milestone conflates asset value with cumulative tokenized-stock trading volume. Solana Foundation's July 6, 2026 primary ecosystem roundup already reported $10B cumulative volume in June 2026, not $10B outstanding tokenized securities. Coinfomania's November 23 report does not provide verifiable new primary metrics or a distinct dated event; reject as stale/recycled milestone rather than publish misleading market-value claim.
